panelKind: Four distinct AI expert agents and one AI moderator, not human professional certification

experts.lens: Game engine import and performance evidence

decisions.finding: Original teaching geometry does not satisfy site-specific fidelity; available captures lack survey control.
decisions.decision: Add actual source-derived geometry and feature-level accuracy contract; retain unknowns and disable physical measurements.
decisions.acceptance: Seven exact-hash models, zero unsupported metric claims; restricted sources stay source references.

decisions.finding: Blender silently removed 11/12 dense-source faces; generic meshopt triangle encoding may rotate index triples.
decisions.decision: Direct OBJ preservation with exact index sequence codec and decoded accessor equality; record Float32 conversion error.
decisions.acceptance: All source triangles, RGB and supplied normals retained; independent decoder and adversarial cases pass.
decisions.result: implemented; 24 tests and seven preservation receipts

decisions.finding: Successful file creation alone does not establish engine import.
decisions.decision: Actual Godot import, pack, instantiation, bounds and source integrity audit.
decisions.acceptance: Original church/mosque/Kailasa counts survive actual engine path.
decisions.result: three actual inputs pass 14 checks each; FPS remains untested

decisions.finding: Upstream installer can exit zero after failure, enables optional MCP fragments and mutates hooks.
decisions.decision: Pinned project-scoped text pack and independent staged synchronizer, within existing role authority.
decisions.acceptance: 119 upstream files hashed; no native grants or hook activation; integrity failures stop safely.
decisions.result: 17 integrity tests; 23 agent definitions, 46 skills and31commands materialized

decisions.acceptance: Visible file sizes, no automatic heavy GLB request, bounded viewer publication.
